related.title: GPON 分光網：分光比與功率裕度
related.titleEn: GPON splitter network: split ratio and power margin
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學雙路失效上限0.001；獨立模型通過、共同風險模型失敗；未知共享關係不能假設獨立。 srlg.csv、事件樹與邏輯到實體路徑映射 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.0004 與變更 0.010396 probability、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching dual-failure limit0.001: independent case passes and shared-risk case fails; unknown sharing is not evidence of independence. srlg.csv, event tree and logical-to-physical route mapping Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.0004 and changed 0.010396 probability, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學剩餘裕度至少0 dB；32分光可行，64分光略負且不可藉四捨五入通過。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching remaining margin must be nonnegative:32-way split passes,64-way is slightly negative and cannot pass by rounding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成各路獨立失效機率0.02，雙路全失效為乘積；變更加入共同管道事件機率0.01，條件獨立其餘不變。 名義式 0.02*0.02 = 0.0004 probability；變更式 0.01+(1-0.01)*0.02*0.02 = 0.010396 probability。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用共同事件/非共同事件的互斥樹枚舉；核對機率和1，不能把共同事件重複相加。

合成可用預算28 dB，固定纖路8 dB、超額2 dB；分光N=32改64。 名義式 28-8-2-10*log10(32) = 2.9485 dB；變更式 28-8-2-10*log10(64) = -0.0617997 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以功率均分為1/N再轉dB核對；逐支路列不平衡損耗，不能把平均裕度當最差支路。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic independent path failure0.02 each; changed case adds a0.01 common-duct event with independent residual failures conditional on no common event. Nominal 0.02*0.02 = 0.0004 probability; changed 0.01+(1-0.01)*0.02*0.02 = 0.010396 probability. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate disjoint common-event/no-common-event branches; verify total probability1 and avoid double counting.

Synthetic allowance28 dB, fixed path8 dB and excess2 dB; change split ratio from32 to64. Nominal 28-8-2-10*log10(32) = 2.9485 dB; changed 28-8-2-10*log10(64) = -0.0617997 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Divide power byN and convert to dB; retain per-branch imbalance instead of using mean margin as the worst branch.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: eCPRI 光前傳：封包化取樣負載
related.titleEn: eCPRI optical fronthaul: packetized sample load
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學雙路失效上限0.001；獨立模型通過、共同風險模型失敗；未知共享關係不能假設獨立。 srlg.csv、事件樹與邏輯到實體路徑映射 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.0004 與變更 0.010396 probability、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching dual-failure limit0.001: independent case passes and shared-risk case fails; unknown sharing is not evidence of independence. srlg.csv, event tree and logical-to-physical route mapping Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.0004 and changed 0.010396 probability, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學鏈路可用5 Gbit/s；4路通過、8路不足；另外檢查時序與抖動，不以平均位元率代替確定延遲。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching available link5 Gbit/s:4 streams pass and8 fail; timing/jitter must be checked separately from mean rate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成各路獨立失效機率0.02，雙路全失效為乘積；變更加入共同管道事件機率0.01，條件獨立其餘不變。 名義式 0.02*0.02 = 0.0004 probability；變更式 0.01+(1-0.01)*0.02*0.02 = 0.010396 probability。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用共同事件/非共同事件的互斥樹枚舉；核對機率和1，不能把共同事件重複相加。

合成4路、30e6 samples/s、I與Q各12 bits、有效比例0.8；變更8路。 名義式 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s；變更式 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在1 ms窗逐流算IQ bytes再除時間；用封包總位元/負載位元反推0.8，不重複加入協定開銷。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic independent path failure0.02 each; changed case adds a0.01 common-duct event with independent residual failures conditional on no common event. Nominal 0.02*0.02 = 0.0004 probability; changed 0.01+(1-0.01)*0.02*0.02 = 0.010396 probability. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate disjoint common-event/no-common-event branches; verify total probability1 and avoid double counting.

Synthetic4 streams,30e6 samples/s,12 bits each forI andQ and0.8 efficiency; change to8 streams. Nominal 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s; changed 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count IQ bytes per stream in a1 ms window and divide by time; recover0.8 from packet/payload counts without adding overhead twice.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
